text:
Mara Chen: Quick sync — running a 48hr experiment to test an anchored CTA that opens the pricing calculator + a condensed FAQ micro-snippet beneath it. Primary goal: fewer inbound ‘which plan do I need’ tickets routed to sales. Thoughts?

Leo Park: Love the idea. Two quick q's: what events/tags are we using so we can map funnel, and where do 'contact sales' leads go (AE vs self-serve)?

Mara Chen: Tagging plan: add utm=calc_anchor to CTA clicks and a slack-tag=pricing_calc_faq on captured leads. Routing heuristic: if user intent selects 'billing' or 'contract' -> AE pipeline; if 'trial' or 'usage' -> docs + support flows. We'll capture intent via a small hidden select inside the calc modal. Example payload we plan to emit:
```json
{
  "event": "calc_submit",
  "variant": "anchored_cta",
  "intent": "billing|trial|limits",
  "utm_source": "pricing_page"
}
```

Anjali (growth): Can the FAQ micro-snippet be indexed by site search? We should avoid duplicate content with /docs/pricing. Also legal wants to review any new plan labels (Enterprise vs Custom).

Sasha V.: We can reuse core FAQ lines but rewrite for the micro-snippet to be action-focused. Suggest 2 variants: 'limits-first' and 'price-first' microcopy. 'limits-first' tends to reduce sales pings.

Evan S.: For analytics, can we add a data attribute to the calc iframe so the dashboard can join events end-to-end? Proposed JS snippet: 
```html
<iframe src="/calc?variant=anchored_cta" data-exp="mk-pricing-2026-08-12"></iframe>
<script>window.dataLayer.push({event:'calc_loaded',exp:'mk-pricing-2026-08-12'})</script>
```

marketing-bot: Experiment created: exp_id=mk-pricing-2026-08-12, variants=[control, anchored_cta, compact_faq]. Auto-report -> #marketing in 48h.

Leo Park: One more routing nuance: if someone clicks 'contact sales' after using the calc and selects "Enterprise", route them to the webinar_vip list (webinar invite + AE follow-up). That will help qualification.

Anjali (growth): Good call. Also flagging: legal review needed for the 'Enterprise' label copy. I'll start the thread.

Sasha V.: I'll draft the two microcopy variants for the anchored CTA + compact FAQ. Will share copy by EOD.

Mara Chen: I'll update the routing map (Google Sheet) and add tests for intent mapping. @Evan S. can you add the three events we agreed on to the tracking plan?

Evan S.: Yep — adding events: 'calc_cta_click', 'calc_submit', 'calc_contact_selected'. Will push to the dashboard and ensure the funnel metric 'calc_click -> contact_rate' is visible.

Leo Park: Nice. If we see >12% reduction in direct sales tickets for calc users vs control, we graduate the anchored CTA. :thumbsup:

Sasha V.: :thumbsup: I'll post copy drafts here when ready.
